title: Future: will / going to / present continuous
recall: Kelajak uchun qachon will, qachon going to, qachon present continuous? when/if dan keyin nima bo'ladi?
formula: will: shu zahoti qaror, va'da, taklif, fikr — I'll help you
going to: oldindan reja yoki hozirgi dalil — Look at the clouds, it's going to rain
present continuous: kelishilgan uchrashuv; present simple: jadval; when/if/as soon as + PRESENT

pairs.b: When I finish, I'll call you.

en: The phone's ringing — I'll get it.
The phone is ringing. I'll get it.
The phone's ringing, I'll answer it.
I'm going to buy a new car.
Look at the clouds — it's going to rain.
Look at those clouds, it's going to rain.

items.uz: Ertaga soat 6 da Ali bilan uchrashaman. (kelishilgan)
en: I'm meeting Ali at 6 tomorrow.
I'm meeting Ali tomorrow at 6.
I'm meeting Ali at six tomorrow.
The train leaves at 7:30.
The train departs at 7:30.
I promise I won't tell anyone.
I promise I will not tell anyone.

items.uz: Ishni tugatishim bilan senga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
en: I'll call you as soon as I finish work.
As soon as I finish work, I'll call you.
I'll call you when I finish work.
If it rains, we'll stay at home.
We'll stay at home if it rains.
If it rains, we'll stay home.
I don't think he'll come.
I don't think he will come.
What are you going to cook for dinner?
What are you going to make for dinner?
Shall I help you with your bag?
Shall I carry your bag?
I'll help you with your bag.
Be careful — you're going to fall!
Be careful, you're going to fall!
What are you doing on Saturday?
I'm going to leave my job next month.
I'm leaving my job next month.
I'll text you when I get home.
When I get home, I'll text you.
I'll message you when I get home.
I think people will live on Mars in 2050.
I think that people will live on Mars by 2050.
I think people will live on Mars by 2050.
The film starts at 8.
The movie starts at 8.
The film starts at eight.
Everything will be fine.
Everything's going to be fine.
Everything is going to be fine.
Everything will be okay.

items.uz: U imtihondan yiqiladi — hech narsa o'qimagan.
en: He's going to fail the exam — he hasn't studied anything.
He's going to fail the exam; he hasn't studied at all.

items.uz: Men senga keyinroq qo'ng'iroq qilaman, hozir bandman.
en: I'll call you later, I'm busy now.
I'll call you later; I'm busy right now.

speak: Kelasi hafta rejalaringiz: going to / present continuous — 5 ta gap.
10 yildan keyin dunyo qanday bo'ladi? (will — fikr)
